listing.name: Jet Set Radio Future (PAL) — JSRF-PAL-Recomp (yacineolivier-maker)
listing.summary: Upstream reports logos, the graffiti warning, title/attract demo, New Game scenes and dialogue, and early gameplay at 60 FPS/1080p with music, voices and effects. Saves and every stage remain untested; a full campaign is unconfirmed. Graphics options include default 175% supersampling with box filtering, lens ghosts/halo, light shafts and brighter additive particles. USA-port results do not apply to this PAL implementation; Portcove has not confirmed gameplay or performance. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own European disc files with title ID 49470018, XDK 4134 and default.xbe SHA-1 edd8547185025834df914724069aa1e63109cbc1, plus the complete Media folder.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the README for JSRF.zip in Releases. Extract it, place your own Europe PAL ISO in assets, or supply its default.xbe and Media folder, then run JSRF.exe. First launch translates and compiles the game locally; later launches reuse that work and still need the original files. A source build uses Visual Studio 2022 C++, Clang, CMake and build.bat. Upstream says release.bat creates a ZIP without original game code; Portcove has not inspected that ZIP.
